detail.title: Investigating Path-Dependent Divergence under Feedback Perturbation
detail.summary: Following the invalid measurement in exp-divergent-values-test-68, the current research cycle revises the hypothesis for divergent values to better constrain feedback parameters, aiming to stabilize distributional measurements against numerical overflow while maintaining conditions for path-dependent divergence.
